title: 第849章 引灵图第848章 最佳销赃搭档
content_zh:
见面礼？
云紫霞迫不及待打开瓶塞，刹那间，一缕丹香如清泉破雾，沁入神魂；细听之下，竟有细微雷音隐现，似九天龙吟，又似春雷初动；丹体悬浮于瓶口，通体澄金，表面丹纹流转如星河倒悬，光华内敛却压得整间雅室灵气为之臣服。
她身为道商会大小姐，见过无数天材地宝，可这枚丹药，丹成有韵，药蕴道痕，分明已触及五品丹道门槛，“你竟炼制出绝品结金丹？”
江凡却只是淡淡一笑，“小意思，若不是你当年在楼船上告诉我，云梦泽深处有‘天元果’伴雷池而生，我也不可能凑齐主药，更炼不出这枚丹。”
云紫霞心头一震，那是五年前的事了。彼时她不过随口一提，本意是试探他是否是大胡子，谁知他竟真敢孤身深入云梦泽雷瘴区，只为等一枚千年一熟的天元果！
她望着那枚丹，忽然低笑出声，眼中却泛起一丝难以言喻的敬意：“你骗了所有人……他们以为你是靠奇遇崛起的散修，却不知，你每一步，都是拿命换来的算计。”
江凡不置可否，只道：“丹道如剑道，心稳、手稳、道稳，方成绝品。凤姥若知我早能自炼结金丹，或许……就不会打轻舞的主意了。”
云紫霞沉默片刻，她将那枚绝品结金丹郑重收入袖中秘匣，声音低而坚定：“这枚丹，我不卖，留着自己突破时使用，就当是道商会与苍玄宗结盟的第一份信物。”
此言一出，意义非凡。道商会向来中立，不站队、不结盟，只做买卖。可今日，云紫霞以一枚丹为契，不是交易，而是盟誓。
江凡静静看着她，眼中青雷微敛，似有千言万语，最终只化作一个字：“好。”
简简单单一字，却重若山岳。他知道，从这一刻起，道商会不再是单纯的中间人，而是苍玄宗在中洲最锋利的暗刃、最坚固的后盾。
云紫霞唇角微扬，转身走向窗边，望向百宝城万家灯火：“销赃少说要半年时间，你接下来有什么打算？”
江凡站在雅间中央，青衣未换，眉宇间风尘未散，却已透出几分沉静如渊的气度，他略一沉吟，答得干脆：“可能要闭关炼丹了。”
云紫霞微微侧首，眼中闪过一丝讶异：“炼丹？你不是刚炼出绝品结金丹？莫非……还要冲击更高品阶？”
“不是，我在昆乾宗与逍遥宗那些长老身上，搜刮了数之不尽的灵草，若放着不用，灵气散逸，反成浪费，也只能把它们炼制成丹药，以备不时之需。”
“若是有多余的，可以让道商会拍卖掉，换取修炼资源。”
“没问题，对了，上次在云梦城，你怎么受伤了？”江凡疑惑望向云紫霞，什么人吃了熊心豹子胆，竟然敢对道商会少主、归墟殿天骄下手？
云紫霞沉默片刻，缓步走到窗边，“是北玄盟的人，准确说，是北玄盟‘影狱司’与魔渊教残部联手设的局。他们不知从何处得知，我手中有半卷《归墟引灵图》，便在云梦泽外围伏杀我，想夺图炼魂。”
“世人皆以为《归墟引灵图》只是功法残卷，可实际上，它记载的，是一条横跨两界的通道，一条连接此方修真界与另一片浩瀚天地的‘归墟之径’。
道商会之所以能崛起为中域第一商会，并非只靠买卖，而是因为—我们掌握着这条通道的秘密，

灵药、矿脉、古器、甚至失传的丹方……许多珍品，都来自彼岸世界。”
她顿了顿，声音忽然低哑：“我父亲……曾多次通过那条通道往返两界，带回无数奇珍，也带回了足以颠覆北域格局的讯息。可三年前，他最后一次进入通道后，再也没有回来。”
江凡神色微动，终于明白，为何云紫霞对《归墟引灵图》如此执着，为何北玄盟不惜与魔渊教联手也要夺图，又为何……她会对他这个小世界之人另眼相待。
原来，他们追寻的，从来不是同一部功法，而是同一条路，同一个答案。
“通道出了什么问题？”江凡问。
云紫霞摇头：“无人知晓，但自那以后，通道变得极不稳定，每隔半年才开启一瞬，且入口被一股混沌之力封锁……我试过三次强行闯入，皆被震回，险些神魂俱灭。”
江凡沉默良久，忽然道：“若我找到你父亲，你要什么？”
云紫霞一怔，随即轻笑，眼中却泛起微光：“我要他亲口告诉我，那彼岸世界，是否真有‘元婴之上’的路？”
江凡闻言，沉默片刻，他缓缓开口，“元婴之上……有化神，炼虚，合体，大乘，渡劫。每一境，皆如登天；每一步，皆踏血骨。”
“你怎么知道？”云紫霞眸光一凝，声音微颤，带着难以置信的惊疑。
江凡负手而立，目光如穿透万古长夜，缓缓道：“我师尊玉玄子，是青霄大陆之人，不足八十岁，便已突破炼虚巅峰。”
云紫霞浑身一震，几乎失声：“炼虚……巅峰？！”
在这方修真界，元婴已是传说，化神近乎神话，而炼虚只存在于上古典籍中的境界，连北玄盟盟主都不敢妄言触及！
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
可玉玄子，竟在八十岁前臻至此境？
江凡继续道，眼中闪过一丝追忆与敬意：“青霄大陆，灵气未衰，道统完整，天道未锁。那里有完整的九品丹道、十重阵域、三十六脉剑宗……更有无数修士，自筑基起便以‘渡劫飞升’为志。”
云紫霞久久无言，指尖微微发颤。她终于明白，为何江凡能炼绝品丹、引归墟雷、斩元婴如刈草；为何他对彼岸世界如此笃定；又为何……他敢以一人之力，对抗整个中域。因为他身后，站着一个完整修真文明的余影。
“所以……”她声音轻得几乎听不见，“你来此界，不只是为了轻舞，也是为了完成你师尊的遗愿？”
江凡望向远方，眸中雷光如海：“我要在此界，重开天路；我要让后来者，不必再困于元婴之墙；我要让轻舞、紫菱、靖雯、子茜……所有人，都能看到化神之上的风景。”
没在道商会久待，销赃之事既已议定，江凡便收下云紫霞预付的一百万中品灵石，独自步入百宝城喧嚣街市。

此刻的他，不似那个剑斩元婴、血洗两宗的“魔头”，倒像一位寻常修士，负手缓行，目光温和地打量着街边商铺。
百宝城果然名不虚传，灵绸坊中，云纹锦缎随风轻舞，一匹“九阳火蚕丝”可隔寒暑、避尘垢，更有“清心斋”专售闭关所用静心香、安神枕、温玉蒲团……
他记得她们的尺寸，记得轻舞偏爱素白，紫菱喜淡青，靖雯爱利落短装，子茜则总嫌衣袖太长。这些琐碎小事，他从不曾言说，却一一记在心底。
为没人采购了十套衣服，足够众女闭关修炼时日常换洗。

content_en:
Meeting gift?
Yun Zixia couldn't wait to uncork the bottle, and in an instant, a wisp of elixir fragrance was like a clear spring breaking through the mist, refreshing her soul; upon listening carefully, there was a subtle sound of thunder, like the dragon's roar in the sky, and like the first spring thunder; the elixir body was suspended in the mouth of the bottle, and the whole body was pure gold.
As the eldest lady of the Taoist Chamber of Commerce, she has seen countless heavenly and earthly treasures, but this elixir has a charm to it, and the medicine contains Dao marks. It has clearly touched the threshold of the fifth-grade elixir. "You actually refined a top-grade gold-forming elixir?"
Jiang Fan just smiled faintly and said, "It's a joke, if you hadn't told me on the boat that there was a 'Tian Yuan Fruit' growing deep in Yunmeng Ze with the thunder pond, I wouldn't have been able to gather the main medicine together, let alone refine this elixir."
Yun Zixia was shocked, that was five years ago. At that time, she just mentioned it casually, and her original intention was to test whether he was a bearded man, but who would have thought that he would actually dare to go deep into the Yunmeng Ze Lei Miasma Area alone, just to wait for a Tianyuan Fruit that ripens once every thousand years!
She looked at the pill and suddenly laughed, but there was a trace of indescribable respect in her eyes: "You deceived everyone... They thought you were a casual cultivator who rose up by chance, but they didn't know that every step you took was based on calculations that cost your life."
Jiang Fan didn't comment and just said: "The way of alchemy is like the way of swordsmanship. Only when the mind is steady, the hands are steady, and the way is steady, can it be perfect. If Grandma Feng knew that I could refine the golden elixir by myself, maybe... she wouldn't have thought about Qingwu."
Yun Zixia was silent for a moment. She solemnly put the top-quality gold-forming elixir into the secret box in her sleeve, and said in a low but firm voice, "I won't sell this elixir. I will keep it for my own breakthrough. It will be regarded as the first token of the alliance between the Taoist Chamber of Commerce and the Cangxuan Sect."
As soon as this statement came out, it was of great significance. The Tao Chamber of Commerce has always been neutral, not taking sides or making alliances, but only doing business. But today, Yun Zixia used a pill as a contract. It was not a transaction, but an oath.
Jiang Fan looked at her quietly, his eyes narrowed slightly, as if he had a thousand words to say, but in the end they turned into just one word: "Okay."
A simple word, but as heavy as a mountain. He knew that from this moment on, the Taoist Chamber of Commerce was no longer a mere middleman, but the sharpest hidden edge and strongest backing of the Cangxuan Sect in Central Continent.
The corners of Yun Zixia's lips raised slightly, and she turned towards the window and looked at the lights of thousands of houses in Baobao City: "Young Master said it would take half a year. What are your plans next?"
Jiang Fan stood in the center of the elegant room. He had not changed into his green clothes, and the dust on his brows had not cleared away, but he already showed a calm demeanor. He pondered for a while and answered simply: "Maybe I have to go into seclusion to refine elixirs."
Yun Zixia tilted her head slightly, a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes: "Refining alchemy? Didn't you just refine the top-grade gold-forming elixir? Could it be that... you want to reach a higher level?"
"No, I have collected countless spiritual herbs from the elders of Kunqian Sect and Xiaoyao Sect. If they are left unused, the spiritual energy will escape and it will be a waste. I can only refine them into elixirs for emergencies."
"If there are any excess, you can let the Taoist Merchant Association auction them off in exchange for cultivation resources."
"No problem. By the way, why were you injured last time in Yunmeng City?" Jiang Fan looked at Yun Zixia in confusion. Who dared to attack the young master of the Taoist Chamber of Commerce and the genius of Guixu Palace?
Yun Zixia was silent for a moment, then walked slowly to the window, "It's people from the Beixuan League. To be precise, it was a trap set up by the Beixuan League's 'Shadow Prison Division' and the remnants of the Moyuan Sect. They didn't know where they found out that I had half a volume of the "Returning to the Ruins to Lead Spirits" in my hand, so they ambushed me outside Yunmeng Ze, trying to seize the map to refine the soul."
"Everyone in the world thinks that the "Picture of Returning to the Ruins to Lead Spirits" is just a fragment of the technique, but in fact, what it records is a passage across two worlds, a 'Path to the Ruins' that connects this world of cultivation to another vast world.
The reason why the Dao Chamber of Commerce can rise to become the first chamber of commerce in the Central Region is not just through buying and selling, but because we hold the secret of this passage.
Spiritual elixirs, mineral veins, ancient artifacts, and even lost elixirs... many treasuresProducts are all from the other side of the world. "
She paused and her voice suddenly became hoarse: "My father... has traveled between the two realms through that passage many times, bringing back countless treasures and information that could overturn the structure of the Northern Territory. But three years ago, after he entered the passage for the last time, he never came back. "
Jiang Fan's expression moved slightly, and he finally understood why Yun Zixia was so obsessed with the "Picture of Guiding Spirits to the Ruins", why the Beixuan Alliance did not hesitate to join forces with the Moyuan Sect to seize the picture, and why... she would treat a person from this small world like him differently.
It turns out that what they were pursuing was never the same technique, but the same path and the same answer.
“What’s wrong with the passage? Jiang Fan asked.
Yun Zixia shook her head: "No one knows, but since then, the passage has become extremely unstable. It only opens for a moment every six months, and the entrance is blocked by a force of chaos... I tried to break in three times, but I was knocked back every time and almost lost my mind. "
Jiang Fan was silent for a long time and suddenly said: "If I find your father, what do you want? "
Yun Zixia was startled, then chuckled, but there was a glimmer in her eyes: "I want him to tell me personally, is there really a way to 'beyond the Nascent Soul' in the other world? "
When Jiang Fan heard this, he was silent for a moment, and then he slowly said, "Above the Nascent Soul... there are those who transform the spirit, refine the void, combine the body, the Mahayana, and overcome the tribulation. Every stage is like ascending to the sky; every step is like stepping on blood and bones. "
"How do you know? "Yun Zixia's eyes narrowed, her voice trembled slightly, with unbelievable surprise.
Jiang Fan stood with his hands behind his hands, his gaze as if penetrating an eternity of night, and said slowly: "My master, Yu Xuanzi, is from the Qingxiao Continent. He is less than eighty years old and has already reached the peak of virtual refining. "
Yun Zixia was shocked and almost lost her voice: "Lianxu...peak? ! "
In this world of cultivation, Nascent Soul is already a legend, transformation into a god is almost a myth, and Lianxu only exists in ancient classics. Even the leader of the Beixuan Alliance dare not touch upon it!
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
But Yu Xuanzi actually reached this level before he was eighty years old?
Jiang Fan continued, with a trace of recollection and respect flashing in his eyes: "In Qingxiao Continent, the aura has not faded, the Taoism is intact, and the way of heaven is not locked. There are complete ninth-grade alchemy paths, ten-level formations, thirty-six-line sword sects... and countless monks who have been aiming to 'overcome tribulations and ascend' since the foundation was established. "
Yun Zixia was speechless for a long time, her fingertips trembling slightly. She finally understood why Jiang Fan was able to refine top-quality elixirs, lead back to the ruins, and chop off the Nascent Soul like mowing grass; why he was so sure of the other world; and why...he dared to fight against the entire Central Territory with the power of one person. Because behind him stood the afterimage of a complete cultivation civilization.
"So..." Her voice was so soft that it was almost inaudible, "You came to this world not only to Qingwu, but also to fulfill your master's last wish? "
Jiang Fan looked into the distance, with thunder in his eyes like a sea: "I want to reopen the road to heaven in this world; I want to let those who come after you no longer have to be trapped in the wall of Nascent Soul; I want Qing Wu, Zi Ling, Jing Wen, Zi Qian... everyone to be able to see the scenery above the Transformation God. "
After not staying long at the Taoist Chamber of Commerce, Jiang Fan accepted the one million mid-grade spiritual stones prepaid by Yun Zixia and walked into the bustling streets of Baobao City alone.
At this moment, he does not look like the "devil" who killed the Nascent Soul with his sword and bloodbathed two sects, but looks like an ordinary monk, walking slowly with his hands behind his back, looking at the shops on the street with gentle eyes.
The Baobao City certainly deserves its reputation. In the Ling Silk Shop, moiré brocades dance in the wind. A piece of "Nine Yang Fire Silk" can protect you from the cold and heat, and protect you from dirt. There is also a "Qingxinzhai" that specializes in selling calming incense, soothing pillows, and warm jade futons for retreats...
He remembered their sizes, remembering that Qingwu preferred plain white, Ziling liked light green, Jingwen liked neat short clothes, and Ziqian always found the sleeves too long. He never spoke of these trivial matters, but kept them in his heart one by one.
